title: Innovation Is Not Staffing
preview: A new kiosk, an old chair, and the hospital's priorities in order.

jokes.setup: The hospital announced a bold new AI initiative to reduce clinician burnout.
jokes.punchline: It will generate a weekly wellness survey, and clinicians will be asked to complete it on their own time.

jokes.setup: My health system just introduced a patient-centered care model.
jokes.punchline: The patient is now at the center of a floor plan, three forms, and a parking structure.

cartoon.caption: “The kiosk is a huge win. The chair is still under review.”
cartoon.alt: A smiling administrator cuts a ribbon on a gleaming kiosk while exhausted nurses queue behind him with a broken chair and carts of paperwork.
